editions.credit: A commentarie of M. Iohn Caluine vppon the Epistle to the Philippians wherein is set out the necessitie and profite of affliction vnto the faithfull, the benefite of God …, in EEBO-TCP A17647 (STC 4402), trans. William Becket (London: [By John Windet] for Nicolas Lyng, and are to be sold at the west dore of S. Paules Church, 1584). Transcription: Text Creation Partnership (EEBO-TCP, University of Michigan and Bodleian Libraries), keyboarded from the EEBO page images (CC0).
